sources.title: CDC "Learn the Signs. Act Early." Developmental Milestones (2022 revision; Zubler JM et al., Pediatrics 2022;149(3):e2021052138). Item text retrieved 2026-10-02 from per-age pages (last reviewed 2026-05-16), e.g. https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/6-months.html

disclaimer.zh: 里程碑用于日常观察与亲子互动参考，不是诊断工具；如有担心请咨询儿科/儿保医生。
disclaimer.en: Milestones are for everyday observation and parent-child interaction reference only, not a diagnostic tool. CDC's 2022 milestones describe what most children (75% or more) can do by each age; if you have concerns, talk with your child's pediatrician or child health provider.

items.zh: 认识熟悉的人
items.en: Knows familiar people

items.zh: 喜欢照镜子看自己
items.en: Likes to look at self in a mirror

items.zh: 会笑出声
items.en: Laughs

items.zh: 会和你轮流发出声音
items.en: Takes turns making sounds with you

items.zh: 会“吹噗噗”（伸出舌头吹气发出噗噗声）
items.en: Blows "raspberries" (sticks tongue out and blows)

items.zh: 会发出尖声的叫声
items.en: Makes squealing noises

items.zh: 把东西放进嘴里来探索
items.en: Puts things in her mouth to explore them

items.zh: 伸手去抓自己想要的玩具
items.en: Reaches to grab a toy she wants

items.zh: 闭上嘴唇表示不想再吃了
items.en: Closes lips to show she doesn't want more food

items.zh: 能从趴着翻身成仰躺
items.en: Rolls from tummy to back

items.zh: 趴着时能用伸直的手臂把上身撑起来
items.en: Pushes up with straight arms when on tummy

items.zh: 坐着时会用手撑着支撑自己
items.en: Leans on hands to support herself when sitting

items.zh: 在陌生人面前会害羞、黏人或害怕
items.en: Is shy, clingy, or fearful around strangers

items.zh: 会做出多种面部表情，比如高兴、难过、生气和惊讶
items.en: Shows several facial expressions, like happy, sad, angry, and surprised

items.zh: 你叫名字时会看过来
items.en: Looks when you call her name

items.zh: 你离开时会有反应（看着你、向你伸手或哭）
items.en: Reacts when you leave (looks, reaches for you, or cries)

items.zh: 和你玩躲猫猫时会微笑或大笑
items.en: Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo

items.zh: 会发出很多不同的声音，比如“mamamama”和“bababababa”
items.en: Makes a lot of different sounds like "mamamama" and "bababababa"

items.zh: 举起双臂要人抱
items.en: Lifts arms up to be picked up

items.zh: 东西掉到看不见的地方时会去找（比如自己的勺子或玩具）
items.en: Looks for objects when dropped out of sight (like his spoon or toy)

items.zh: 会把两样东西互相敲打
items.en: Bangs two things together

items.zh: 能自己坐起来
items.en: Gets to a sitting position by herself

items.zh: 能把东西从一只手换到另一只手
items.en: Moves things from one hand to her other hand

items.zh: 会用手指把食物“耙”到自己面前
items.en: Uses fingers to "rake" food towards himself

items.zh: 不用支撑能独坐
items.en: Sits without support

items.zh: 会和你玩游戏，比如拍手游戏（pat-a-cake）
items.en: Plays games with you, like pat-a-cake

items.zh: 会挥手“拜拜”
items.en: Waves "bye-bye"

items.zh: 会用“mama”“dada”或其他专门的称呼叫爸爸妈妈
items.en: Calls a parent "mama" or "dada" or another special name

items.zh: 听得懂“不”（你说“不”时会短暂停顿或停下来）
items.en: Understands "no" (pauses briefly or stops when you say it)

items.zh: 会把东西放进容器里，比如把积木放进杯子
items.en: Puts something in a container, like a block in a cup

items.zh: 会去找看到你藏起来的东西，比如藏在毯子下的玩具
items.en: Looks for things he sees you hide, like a toy under a blanket

items.zh: 能扶着东西拉起身站起来
items.en: Pulls up to stand

items.zh: 能扶着家具走
items.en: Walks, holding on to furniture

items.zh: 在你扶着杯子时，能用无盖杯喝水
items.en: Drinks from a cup without a lid, as you hold it

items.zh: 能用拇指和食指捏起东西，比如小块食物
items.en: Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food

items.zh: 玩耍时会模仿其他孩子，比如别的孩子从容器里往外拿玩具时也跟着拿
items.en: Copies other children while playing, like taking toys out of a container when another child does

items.zh: 会把自己喜欢的东西拿给你看
items.en: Shows you an object she likes

items.zh: 兴奋时会拍手
items.en: Claps when excited

items.zh: 会抱毛绒娃娃或其他玩具
items.en: Hugs stuffed doll or other toy

items.zh: 会向你表达亲昵（抱你、依偎你或亲你）
items.en: Shows you affection (hugs, cuddles, or kisses you)

items.zh: 除了“mama”“dada”之外，会尝试说一两个词，比如用“ba”表示球（ball）、用“da”表示狗（dog）
items.en: Tries to say one or two words besides "mama" or "dada," like "ba" for ball or "da" for dog

items.zh: 你说出熟悉物品的名称时，会看向那个物品
items.en: Looks at a familiar object when you name it

items.zh: 能听从同时带手势和话语的指令。例如，你伸出手说“把玩具给我”时，会把玩具递给你
items.en: Follows directions given with both a gesture and words. For example, he gives you a toy when you hold out your hand and say, "Give me the toy."

items.zh: 会用手指着来要东西或求助
items.en: Points to ask for something or to get help

items.zh: 会尝试以正确的方式使用物品，比如电话、杯子或书
items.en: Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book

items.zh: 能把至少两个小物件叠起来，比如积木
items.en: Stacks at least two small objects, like blocks

items.zh: 能自己走几步
items.en: Takes a few steps on his own

items.zh: 能用手指自己吃一些食物
items.en: Uses fingers to feed herself some food

items.zh: 会离开你走开，但会回头看，确认你就在附近
items.en: Moves away from you, but looks to make sure you are close by

items.zh: 会用手指着给你看有趣的东西
items.en: Points to show you something interesting

items.zh: 会伸出手让你给他/她洗手
items.en: Puts hands out for you to wash them

items.zh: 会和你一起看几页书
items.en: Looks at a few pages in a book with you

items.zh: 你给他/她穿衣时会配合，比如把胳膊伸进袖子或抬起脚
items.en: Helps you dress him by pushing arm through sleeve or lifting up foot

items.zh: 除了“mama”“dada”之外，会尝试说三个或更多的词
items.en: Tries to say three or more words besides "mama" or "dada"

items.zh: 能听从不带任何手势的一步指令，比如你说“给我”时会把玩具递给你
items.en: Follows one-step directions without any gestures, like giving you the toy when you say, "Give it to me."

items.zh: 会模仿你做家务，比如用扫帚扫地
items.en: Copies you doing chores, like sweeping with a broom

items.zh: 会用简单的方式玩玩具，比如推玩具车
items.en: Plays with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car

items.zh: 不扶任何人或东西能独立行走
items.en: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything

items.zh: 会涂鸦
items.en: Scribbles

items.zh: 能用无盖杯喝水，有时可能会洒出来
items.en: Drinks from a cup without a lid and may spill sometimes

items.zh: 能用手指自己吃东西
items.en: Feeds himself with his fingers

items.zh: 会尝试使用勺子
items.en: Tries to use a spoon

items.zh: 不需要帮助就能爬上、爬下沙发或椅子
items.en: Climbs on and off a couch or chair without help

items.zh: 能注意到别人受伤或难过，比如有人哭时会停下来或露出难过的样子
items.en: Notices when others are hurt or upset, like pausing or looking sad when someone is crying

items.zh: 在新情境中会看你的表情来决定怎么反应
items.en: Looks at your face to see how to react in a new situation

items.zh: 你问的时候能指出书里的东西，比如“小熊在哪里？”
items.en: Points to things in a book when you ask, like "Where is the bear?"

items.zh: 能把至少两个词连在一起说，比如“还要奶”（More milk.）
items.en: Says at least two words together, like "More milk."

items.zh: 你让他/她指给你看时，能指出至少两个身体部位
items.en: Points to at least two body parts when you ask him to show you

items.zh: 除了挥手和用手指，还会用更多手势，比如飞吻或点头表示“是”
items.en: Uses more gestures than just waving and pointing, like blowing a kiss or nodding yes

items.zh: 能一只手拿着东西、同时用另一只手操作；例如一手拿着容器、另一手把盖子拿掉
items.en: Holds something in one hand while using the other hand; for example, holding a container and taking the lid off

items.zh: 会尝试使用玩具上的开关、旋钮或按钮
items.en: Tries to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy

items.zh: 能同时玩不止一个玩具，比如把玩具食物放到玩具盘子上
items.en: Plays with more than one toy at the same time, like putting toy food on a toy plate

items.zh: 会踢球
items.en: Kicks a ball

items.zh: 会跑
items.en: Runs

items.zh: 在有或没有帮助的情况下，能走（不是爬）上几级台阶
items.en: Walks (not climbs) up a few stairs with or without help

items.zh: 能用勺子吃饭
items.en: Eats with a spoon

items.zh: 会在其他孩子旁边玩，有时会和他们一起玩
items.en: Plays next to other children and sometimes plays with them

items.zh: 会说“看我！”来向你展示自己会做的事
items.en: Shows you what she can do by saying, "Look at me!"

items.zh: 被提醒时能遵循简单的日常程序，比如你说“该收拾啦”时会帮忙捡玩具
items.en: Follows simple routines when told, like helping to pick up toys when you say, "It's clean-up time."

items.zh: 大约会说50个词
items.en: Says about 50 words

items.zh: 能把两个或更多的词连在一起说，其中包含一个动作词，比如“狗狗跑”（Doggie run）
items.en: Says two or more words together, with one action word, like "Doggie run"

items.zh: 你指着书问“这是什么？”时，能说出书中东西的名称
items.en: Names things in a book when you point and ask, "What is this?"

items.zh: 会说“我”“我们”这类词（原文为 "I"、"me"、"we"）
items.en: Says words like "I," "me," or "we"

items.zh: 会用物品做假装游戏，比如把积木当作食物喂给娃娃
items.en: Uses things to pretend, like feeding a block to a doll as if it were food

items.zh: 表现出简单的解决问题能力，比如站到小凳子上去够东西
items.en: Shows simple problem-solving skills, like standing on a small stool to reach something

items.zh: 能听从两步指令，比如“把玩具放下，然后把门关上。”
items.en: Follows two-step instructions like "Put the toy down and close the door."

items.zh: 表现出至少认识一种颜色，比如你问“哪个是红色的？”时能指出红色蜡笔
items.en: Shows he knows at least one color, like pointing to a red crayon when you ask, "Which one is red?"

items.zh: 会用手拧东西，比如转动门把手或拧开盖子
items.en: Uses hands to twist things, like turning doorknobs or unscrewing lids

items.zh: 能自己脱下一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子或敞开的外套
items.en: Takes some clothes off by himself, like loose pants or an open jacket

items.zh: 能双脚同时离地跳起
items.en: Jumps off the ground with both feet

items.zh: 你给他/她读书时，能一次翻一页
items.en: Turns book pages, one at a time, when you read to her

items.zh: 你离开后能在10分钟内平静下来，比如送去托育机构时
items.en: Calms down within 10 minutes after you leave her, like at a childcare drop off

items.zh: 会注意到其他孩子，并加入他们一起玩
items.en: Notices other children and joins them to play

items.zh: 能和你对话，至少有两轮来回交流
items.en: Talks with you in conversation using at least two back-and-forth exchanges

items.zh: 会问“谁”“什么”“哪里”或“为什么”的问题，比如“妈妈/爸爸在哪里？”
items.en: Asks "who," "what," "where," or "why" questions, like "Where is mommy/daddy?"

items.zh: 被问到时，能说出图片或书里正在发生的动作，比如“跑”“吃”或“玩”
items.en: Says what action is happening in a picture or book when asked, like "running," "eating," or "playing"

items.zh: 被问到时能说出自己的名字（first name）
items.en: Says first name, when asked

items.zh: 大多数时候说话清楚到别人能听懂
items.en: Talks well enough for others to understand, most of the time

items.zh: 你示范之后，能画一个圆
items.en: Draws a circle, when you show him how

items.zh: 你提醒之后，会避免碰触烫的东西，比如炉子
items.en: Avoids touching hot objects, like a stove, when you warn her

items.zh: 能把东西串起来，比如大珠子或通心粉
items.en: Strings items together, like large beads or macaroni

items.zh: 能自己穿上一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子或外套
items.en: Puts on some clothes by himself, like loose pants or a jacket

items.zh: 会用叉子
items.en: Uses a fork
